This is in continuation of our earlier intimation dated December 20, 2025 regarding the setting up of the new Multilayer Board Plant (Unit VI) at Dahej, Gujarat.Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III and other applicable provisions of the SEBI Listing Regulations, we are pleased to inform you that the Company has received approvals from Gujarat Industrial Development Corporation (GIDC) for:  Effluent disposal of 2,000 KLPD (2.0 MLD) through the GIDC pipeline; and  Water assurance aggregating 4,000 KLPD (4.0 MLD) comprising 2,600 KLPD Narmada Water and 1,400 KLPD Desalination Water.Pursuant to the above approvals, the Company is required to pay approximately ₹4.92 crore as advance towards capital contribution and related charges as per prevailing GIDC policy.These approvals represent a key milestone in the infrastructure readiness of Unit VI and ensure availability of essential utilities for the project. There is no adverse impact on the Company s existing operations.Further updates shall be disclosed as and when material.

N R Agarwal Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III and other applicable provisions of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, a fire broke out on Friday, September 19, 2025 at 6.15 p.m. at our Unit-I plant located at Plot No.169, Phase II, GIDC, Vapi   396 195, Dist. Valsad, Gujarat. First fire was noticed in Electrical Transformer which spread to Electrical PCC room, VFDs, ACBs, LT and HT cables, etc. The fire was controlled by using in-house firefighting systems and also fire tenders from GIDC Vapi. The Company has Industrial All Risk Insurance Policy and the claim has been lodged. The estimated monetary loss is approximately Rs. 4 crores and estimated production loss is approximately 2300 MT. The said plant is expected to be in operation in 7 days time. This is for your information and records.
